title: Benchmark results
description: results.json: what `bench summarize` derives from one run's run.jsonl, and the only data the benchmarks pages read. Labels, units, better direction, step order and colours come from the pinned methodology release; this file carries ids and numbers. Every property's description ends with `Read by:` and the ids of the readers (see `readers`) that draw it. Read by: build.

readers.build: The web build: pin and version checks, the join keys every panel selects cells by, the provider pages and sitemap it draws.
readers.downloads: /benchmarks/results.json, run.jsonl, results.md and llms.txt, and their immutable run addresses.
readers.run-chip: The run date chip, the partial-run banner and the region label.
readers.bars: Every panel's bar headline: Median, Mean, p95 or Slowest, the 95% CI band, Box and Spread.
readers.hover: Hover cards, the readout and drill-down rows.
readers.steps: Stacked step segments, the lone step, step switches and drill-down step rows.
readers.stages: DeepSWE, Terminal-Bench and GitHub Actions stage segments and command rows.
readers.start-time: Sequential TTI's sandbox picker, All TTI runs and the Cold Startup hero.
readers.cost: Cost views, the cost Box and Spread, and the Reported or Calculated label.
readers.suites: The All traces, jobs and tasks views, the suite p95, and unit rows on provider pages.
readers.failures: Failure lines under charts and the failure list with its evidence.
readers.states: Not displayed, the Incomplete marker and "Benchmark in development".
readers.indexes: The Speed Index and Cost Index (overview hero and panel) and the Providers table's index columns.

schema.description: Format id with the major version; the web accepts exactly one major. Read by: build.

run.description: The run the file was summarized from. Read by: run-chip, downloads.

cells.description: One cell per provider x methodology document x variant the config planned, sorted by document, variant and provider. Read by: build, bars, states.

pools.description: One pool per provider and replay-suite document, over that document's variants in this run. Read by: suites, frontier.

indexes.description: The cross-cell values of the methodology's 01-indexes documents (decision D1a). Read by: indexes, score-tree.

Id.description: A methodology or provider id, never a sentence; a provider is `<provider>#<class>` once its class is known. Read by: build.

Run.description: The one run every number in the file comes from. Read by: run-chip, downloads.

id.description: The run id; names the immutable download addresses. Read by: run-chip, downloads.

started_at.description: UTC start of the run's first trial. Read by: run-chip, downloads.

ended_at.description: UTC end of the run's last trial; the date the chip shows. Read by: run-chip, downloads.

region.description: The runner host's region, for the "measured from" line. Read by: run-chip.

methodology.description: Methodology release the formulas came from; the build refuses a pin whose version differs from the pinned methodology text. Read by: build.

config_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the resolved workloads.yaml. Read by: downloads.

lines_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the run.jsonl bytes summarized. Read by: downloads.

lines.description: Number of lines in run.jsonl. Read by: downloads.

summarize.description: Version of `bench summarize` that wrote the file. Read by: downloads.

Cell.description: One provider x document x variant. Read by: build, bars, states.

provider.description: Provider id; part of every panel's join key. Read by: build.

document.description: Methodology document id; part of every panel's join key. Read by: build.

variant.description: Methodology variant id, or null for a document without variants; part of every panel's join key. Read by: build.

state.description: complete: at least N successes. partial: attempted, fewer than N, failures listed. missing: planned, no line. unsupported: the provider does not offer what the workload requires. Read by: states.

trials.description: Trial counts. Read by: hover, states, failures, run-chip.

planned.description: N, the successes the config planned; the "of N" in "k of N". Read by: hover, states.

attempted.description: Trials with a line; the length of every `values` array in the cell. Read by: hover.

succeeded.description: Successful trials; the k in "k of N". Read by: hover, states.

failed.description: Trials that did not succeed whose owner is the provider or unknown (RULES.md 10). Read by: failures, hover.

excluded.description: Trials that did not succeed whose owner is BoxRouter. Read by: failures, hover.

uncertain.description: Trials whose outcome is uncertain, counted apart. Read by: run-chip.

timing_excluded.description: Successes with a step lacking a measured `provider_transport` time. Read by: run-chip.

failures.description: Failed and excluded trials grouped by step, outcome and owner; empty when none. Read by: failures.

unsupported.description: Unsupported cells: the line's code (`not_applicable`, `size_larger_than_asked`, a refusal's) and reason. Read by: states.

larger_size.description: An operation cell run at the provider's smallest size that holds the asked one, larger in CPU or memory; flag it. Read by: states.

memory_mib.description: Memory in MiB. Read by: states.

metrics.description: One series per methodology metric name. Read by: bars, hover.

steps.description: One series per procedure step id. Read by: steps, hover.

unmeasured.description: Series that leave out successes lacking a trusted provider time. Read by: hover.

trials.description: Successes left out. Read by: hover.

reasons.description: No provider time, or flagged by the coverage cross-check. Read by: hover.

metrics.description: By metric name. Read by: hover.

steps.description: By step id. Read by: hover.

stages.description: Replay suites: one series per stage id, with its commands. Read by: stages.

sandboxes.description: Per-sandbox documents (sequential-tti, burst): item k is sandbox position k+1. Read by: start-time.

cost.description: Present only where the methodology publishes cost for the document. Read by: cost, frontier.

Failure.description: Trials that ended the same way at the same step. Read by: failures.

step.description: Step id where the trial ended, or null when no step failed. Read by: failures.

outcome.description: How the step ended; the methodology's reason template gives the words. Read by: failures.

owner.description: provider: counted as failed; otherwise excluded. Read by: failures.

count.description: Number of trials in the group. Read by: failures.

trials.description: The evidence rows. Read by: failures.

id.description: Trial id from the line. Read by: failures.

sandbox_ids.description: Sandbox ids the trial used. Read by: failures.

error.description: Sanitized error text from the line. Read by: failures.

SeriesFields.description: The statistics of one quantity over a cell's successes: the methodology's nearest rank, nothing trimmed, each number rounded once to 5 significant figures. Every statistic is null when n is 0. Read by: bars, hover.

n.description: Successes the statistics are over; samples for a per-call metric. Read by: hover.

median.description: Median; the lower middle value of an even count. Read by: bars.

p25.description: Nearest rank at 0.25, the Box's lower edge. Read by: bars.

p75.description: Nearest rank at 0.75, the Box's upper edge. Read by: bars.

p99.description: Per-call metric only: the worse-side p99. Read by: hover.

p95.description: Worse-side tail (p5 where higher is better); null below the methodology's tail floor of 20 successes, when the page shows Slowest or Lowest. Read by: bars, hover.

min.description: Smallest value; Lowest, Box and Spread. Read by: bars.

max.description: Largest value; Slowest, Box and Spread. Read by: bars.

mean.description: Arithmetic mean; the Mean statistic, and the headline of cost. Read by: bars, cost.

ci.description: The methodology's seeded bootstrap 95% interval [low, high] of the median (of the mean for cost); null below 2 successes. Read by: bars, hover.

values.description: One entry per attempted trial in run order (started_at, then trial id), null for a trial without a success; index i is the same trial in every series of the cell. Absent in the head. Read by: bars, steps, start-time, hover.

Series.description: One quantity's statistics and per-trial values. Read by: bars, hover.

SeriesMap.description: Series by methodology id. Read by: bars, steps, hover.

Stage.description: A replay stage's series, with the commands run in it. Read by: stages.

commands.description: Command rows of the stage. Read by: stages.

name.description: The program as the replay line names it. Read by: stages.

count.description: Calls of the program in the stage. Read by: stages.

Sandbox.description: One sandbox position's series, aligned by trial with the cell's. Read by: start-time.

metrics.description: Metric series of this position. Read by: start-time.

steps.description: Step series of this position. Read by: start-time.

Cost.description: Provider cost as read, never estimated. Read by: cost, frontier.

label.description: reported: every success's cost is Reported. calculated: each is Reported or Calculated. unknown: some success has no cost. Read by: cost.

per_success_usd.description: Cost per success in USD: mean with its bootstrap. Absent when label is unknown. Read by: cost, frontier.

unknown.description: Successes without a cost; the page names the count. Read by: cost, indexes.

reason.description: Present when label is unknown: the methodology's `not_displayed` reason id, `no-provider-cost` when no success has a cost, else `trial-without-provider-cost`. Read by: cost, states.

not_final.description: Successes whose cost may still change. Read by: cost.

Pool.description: A replay suite's variants for one provider, combined by the methodology's rule; formed only when every variant was planned with the same N. Read by: suites, frontier.

document.description: Replay-suite methodology document id. Read by: suites.

variants.description: The variants pooled, in methodology order; their cells hold the per-variant series. Read by: suites.

trials_per_variant.description: N planned for every variant. Read by: suites.

state.description: complete when every variant's cell is complete. Read by: suites, states.

metrics.description: One workload value per methodology metric name. Read by: suites, frontier.

value.description: Geometric mean over variants of each variant's statistic. Read by: suites, frontier.

p95.description: Nearest rank over the pooled successes; null unless every variant is complete and the pool has at least 20 successes. Read by: suites.

filled.description: Variants this provider did not complete, each with the value it was filled with; the All drill-down's fill sentence reads it. Read by: suites.

variant.description: The filled variant's id. Read by: suites.

value.description: The slowest value any provider recorded on the variant, on each unit statistic; null where none did. Read by: suites.

steps.description: One workload value per result step id, from the variants' steps added over each trial's sandboxes, combined as `metrics` are; absent when no variant recorded a step. Read by: suites.

cost.description: The suite's cost per success, where the methodology publishes cost. Read by: cost, frontier.

label.description: The weakest label of the pooled cells. Read by: cost.

value.description: Geometric mean over variants of each variant's cost, a variant the provider did not complete taking the highest cost any provider recorded on it (01-indexes/cost.yaml); null when label is unknown. Read by: cost, frontier.

reason.description: Present when label is unknown: `no-provider-cost` when no pooled cell has a provider-sourced cost, else `trial-without-provider-cost` (ids of the methodology's cost documents). Read by: cost, states.

p95.description: Nearest rank over the pooled per-success costs; null unless every variant is complete and the pool has at least the tail floor's successes. Read by: cost.

filled.description: Variants this provider did not complete, each with the highest cost any provider recorded on it. Read by: cost.

Value.description: A combined value on each unit statistic; null where no value exists. Read by: suites, frontier.

median.description: Taken over each variant's median. Read by: suites, frontier.

mean.description: Taken over each variant's mean. Read by: suites, frontier.

Index.description: One index on one scope and unit statistic, computed from an 01-indexes document's composition. Read by: indexes, score-tree.

document.description: The 01-indexes methodology document that defines it. Read by: indexes, score-tree.

metric.description: The document's metric name; gives the unit and better direction. Read by: indexes, score-tree.

scope.description: The composition scope id, or null when the document has no scopes. Read by: indexes.

statistic.description: The unit statistic the reader picks. Read by: indexes, score-tree.

providers.description: One row per included provider. Read by: indexes, score-tree.

provider.description: Provider id. Read by: indexes, score-tree.

value.description: The provider's index value; null when not displayed. Read by: indexes.

reason.description: On a cost index or cost score row whose value is null: the id of the `not_displayed` reason in the methodology's cost documents that holds (`no-provider-cost`, `trial-without-provider-cost` or `zero-unit-cost`); absent when the value is present. Read by: indexes, states.

filled.description: Input documents the provider has no result in, filled by the composition's rule. Read by: indexes.

parts.description: The value each input took, or the score tree's top parts. Read by: indexes, score-tree.

IndexPart.description: One node of an index's tree: a group, an input document, a unit of a scored workload, or one document of a summed leaf. Read by: indexes, score-tree, suites.

id.description: Composition input, group, unit (variant) or summed document id. Read by: indexes, score-tree, suites.

value.description: The node's value in the index's metric; on a unit, the provider's score there (0 for a unit it has no result on); null on a summed leaf's document. Read by: indexes, score-tree, suites.

rank.description: 1 is best; null where the index does not rank. Read by: score-tree, suites.

of.description: Providers ranked. Read by: score-tree, suites.

input.description: The measured value in the document's unit: a score-tree leaf's, a summed leaf document's, or the provider's own value on a unit (null where it has none). Read by: score-tree, suites.

parts.description: Child nodes: a time or cost score's workload part holds one part per unit some provider has a value on, and a summed score-tree leaf one part per document; empty on any other leaf. Read by: score-tree, suites.
